cost_decomposition.what_it_is_not: a cost per prediction, per signal, per day, or per position update — it is a cost per unit of notional actually traded

gate_v2_and_pass_region_preflight.controlled_well: decision-grade hypothesis claims: alpha=0.05, 80% power, two independent panels, no pooling — the right standard for CLOSING or CONFIRMING a family
gate_v2_and_pass_region_preflight.structurally_could_not_see: any development activity on <=2-year panels: the composite needs 3.488 effective years per panel, so applied to development it forbids discovery as such rather than distinguishing good from bad discovery. Appropriate as a confirmation gate; not an architecture-evaluation instrument

model_learning_feasibility_gate.controlled_well: capacity accounting (parameters vs years, breadth and frequency cancel), leakage shapes, closed-family reopening, and the corrected unit discipline (cost and volatility per unit of gross)

structurally_could_not_see.consequence: daily designs were charged 858 bp/yr against a measured 125 bp/yr for the smooth book — break-even gross IR 2.27 against an actual 0.33 — and ECONOMICALLY_UNREACHABLE verdicts inherited that factor of 6.9

one selection was priced at 10.8 out-of-fold years, which no development corpus will ever have; the standard belongs at the one-shot confirmation layer, where the fresh pool and forward data pay for it
structurally_could_not_see.finding: confirmation-level family-wise error (alpha=0.05) charged to development selection

structurally_could_not_see.consequence: per-event MRE and per-trade expectancy cannot represent an architecture whose profit is edge x breadth x utilization - turnover x cost at the portfolio level
structurally_could_not_see.finding: single-trade economics as the unit of account

pair_routing.identity: cost per turnover unit = R x pair round trip (2.58 bp)
